Kartik Purnima holy bath restrictions and auspicious timings

Restrictions on large vehicles entering Siddharthanagar for the Kartik Purnima holy bath will be in effect from November 24, starting at 3 AM until the bathing period concludes. This year's Kartik Purnima, observed for bathing and charity, will have three auspicious timings. The primary auspicious period for bathing and charity is from 5:03 AM to 5:57 AM, falling during the Brahma Muhurta. Additional timings for bathing and charity will be available for those who miss the initial slot.
